topics.topic: Identity and minting time of the pending confirmation one-time value
questions: Is the pending confirmation’s one-time value the confirmation id, minted when the confirmation step is shown, or is it a separate value from a confirmation id minted only when the owner confirms?
Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the confirmation id, and exactly when is that identifier minted?

Are the pending one-time value and the audited confirmation id the same identifier; if so, is it minted when the step is shown or when the action is confirmed, and if not, who mints the one-time value and what relationship do the two identifiers have?

judgement.why: P2 already decides that the pending one-time value and confirmation id are distinct and specifies when each is minted.

precedent.topic: Whether the one-time confirmation value and audited confirmation id are identical and when the id is minted
quotes:
It is not
   the confirmation id, which Registry mints only when the action is accepted
   (A14).

A confirmation id is minted only for an accepted, confirmed action that
   changes state, and is written into its entry (and, for the import, into the
   migration closure); a confirmed action that changes nothing mints none.
precedent.why: State 2 expressly makes the one-time confirmation value distinct from the confirmation id and mints the latter only when a confirmed state-changing action is accepted.

topics.topic: Requests that update the OwnerSession last-request instant
questions: Which requests move the last-request instant: every authenticated owner-interface request, only product actions, only successful requests, or some other declared set?
Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant?
Which requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only owner-interface page and form requests, only successful requests, or some stated subset?

judgement.why: P5 already decides which owner-interface requests update the last-request instant.

precedent.topic: Which owner-interface requests update the OwnerSession last-request instant
quotes:
An owner request is any request to the owner interface that
   carries the valid session, whatever its answer; it restarts the 30
   minutes; before the first request it runs from the sign-in.
precedent.why: State 2 defines the last-request event as every owner-interface request carrying a valid session, regardless of its answer.

topics.topic: Storage and disclosure classification of personal import inputs in a pending confirmation
questions: When an import confirmation is bound to inputs containing personal values, does the pending confirmation store those values and therefore carry `personal_data`, or only a non-personal reference or digest so that every non-file OwnerSession fact remains `business_confidential`?

What disclosure class applies to personal-data inputs bound into a pending import confirmation, and does the pending confirmation store those values or only a non-personal reference to the uploaded file?

When confirmation inputs contain project display names, customer data, object data or other imported personal values, does the pending confirmation store those values, making those facts `personal_data`, or only a non-personal reference or digest?

judgement.why: P1 already decides how an import confirmation binds personal inputs while preserving the OwnerSession fact classifications.

precedent.topic: How pending import confirmations bind personal inputs without violating OwnerSession disclosure classifications
quotes:
An action that asks for confirmation (Identity formats) is submitted with a
   confirmation value Registry made when it showed the step: one-time, kept in
   the owner session, bound to the action, its target, the revision or access
   version the step showed, and its inputs — for the import, the file's digest
   and the picks.

The owner confirms that mapping in the confirmation
   step (A13 rule 6); the confirmation applies the file of that digest, the
   picks, names, aliases and Customer values the mapping showed, nothing
   else; a file no longer kept is refused and must be uploaded again.
precedent.why: State 2 binds the pending confirmation to the file digest and the mapping picks and requires confirmation to apply exactly the names, aliases and Customer values shown, leaving copying versus referencing as an unobservable implementation detail.

topics.topic: When a pending confirmation is used and cleared after submission, refusal, cancellation, or revisit
questions: What counts as the pending confirmation being “used,” and what happens to it when the submitted action is refused, the owner cancels, or the confirmation page is merely revisited?
When is a pending confirmation considered used and cleared if submission is invalid, stale, or the confirmed product action is refused?

Does submitting the one-time value clear the pending confirmation even when the value is wrong, the bound revision or access version is stale, the target has changed, or the confirmed action is otherwise refused, or only when the action is accepted?

judgement.why: P4 already decides exactly when a confirmation submission consumes and clears the pending value, including refused submissions.

precedent.topic: Which confirmation-submission event consumes and clears a pending confirmation
quotes:
It is valid only in that session, for 10
   minutes, and is
   used up by the first submission, whatever its answer; a refused submission
   needs the step shown again. A submission becomes the first one when it
   passes the owner session and CSRF checks (A04 rule 6, stage 1): one refused
   before them leaves the value unused; from there on, whatever the answer —
   a value bound to another action included — the value is used up.
precedent.why: State 2 says precisely when submission consumes the value and distinguishes failures before owner-session and CSRF checks from every answer after those checks.

topics.topic: Retention or deletion of an uploaded import file after refusal, abandonment, or cancellation
questions: After a confirmed import is refused, or after the owner abandons or cancels the import, does the uploaded file remain available for retry or get dropped?
What happens to the uploaded file when import is refused, its confirmation is abandoned or replaced, or the owner cancels the attempt before the session ends?

judgement.why: P3 already decides every event that retains, replaces, reads or drops the uploaded import file.

precedent.topic: Which action uploads, replaces, reads, and removes the staged import file
quotes:
The owner uploads the export file (R0-72) in the owner interface. Registry
   reads it as data (A19) and answers, without changing anything, each
   project the file holds with its id and status.

The uploaded file is kept in the owner session that uploaded it, never in
   the store, until the import is accepted, another file is uploaded in that
   session, or the session ends (M11); then it is dropped. A refused
   confirmation keeps it, and the step may be shown again.
precedent.why: State 2 defines upload as a distinct owner-interface action, replacement by another upload, reading by the confirmed import, and every event that drops the staged file.

topics.topic: Whether uploading or replacing an import file is a distinct owner product action
questions: Is uploading or replacing the file a distinct owner product action that changes OwnerSession, or is it an internal step of the existing “import projects with their identity” action?

Is uploading the migration file a distinct owner product action that stores or replaces the session fact, and does the confirmed import always read the current file from that same session rather than receiving a file again?

judgement.why: P3 already decides that upload is a distinct owner-interface action and that confirmed import reads the staged file from that session.

topics.topic: Effect of replacing an uploaded file on an existing import confirmation
questions: If the owner uploads another file after an import confirmation has been shown, does that upload clear or replace the pending confirmation, leave it bound to the now-removed old file, or retarget it to the new file?

topics.topic: Facts and versions bound into each pending confirmation
questions: For each confirming product action, which target, version and input facts are actually stored in the pending confirmation, including what “access version” applies to when none of the currently confirmed primary actions changes session access?

topics.topic: Whether the mutable last-request instant belongs inside OwnerSession
questions: Is OwnerSession an exception that carries a mutable instant, or must the last-request instant be removed or represented outside the model?
